g.text: LEVEL 1 // APPLICATION ROOT & GLOBAL NAVIGATION BUS
LEVEL 0: GLOBAL APPLICATION FRAMEWORK (SHARED ACROSS ALL 7 PAGES)
• 7-Link Desktop Navigation (Home, About, Awards, Exp, Tech, Interests, Contact)
• Pure CSS Hamburger Menu Toggle for responsive mobile/tablet displays
• Sticky position with frosted backdrop glassmorphism
• Dark cyber defense palette: #030712 background with cyan/purple/emerald
• Dual Typography: JetBrains Mono (technical code) & Plus Jakarta Sans (body)
• Micro-interactions: Card tilt effects, glowing pulse dots, animated borders
• Strict responsive media queries (@media screen max-width: 900px, 600px)
• Yasio.dev-inspired custom canvas trailing mouse cursor script
• Dynamic particle follower reacting to pointer speed and direction
• WhatsApp message pre-fill formatter and URI encoder dispatcher
• Zero external library dependencies (Pure Vanilla ECMAScript)
• Direct social shortcuts: GitHub, X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook
• Internal anchor hyperlink: Back to Top ↑ targeting #top
• Persistent across 100% of pages in accordance with assignment brief
